headline: Get Emberpup
title: How to Get Emberpup | Your First Fire Aniimo | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Emberpup is a Fire Aniimo and number one in the Aniimo list. You can meet it in Nimbus Fields, and later in Beast Fang Ridge, The Argent Strait and more. It can also hatch from a Grassland Egg. Its Fire Kick and Scorching Flames trait deal extra damage to weak targets. At level twelve it becomes Flameruff, after you clear Sanctum First Spark. Is Emberpup on your team? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Emberpup is a Fire Aniimo found in Nimbus Fields, Beast Fang Ridge and other areas, or hatched from a Grassland Egg. It evolves into Flameruff at level 12 after clearing Sanctum: First Spark.
